The '''Moon Channel''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that ran between the continents of [[Kato Zakar]] and [[Talss]]. The city of [[Ban Landing]] was located on the coast of Kato Zakar, and the seven [[Moon Islands]] were located in the Channel. Crossing the Channel was considered treacherous as great sea creatures inhabited the rough waters. Scheduled passage on larger, armored vessels was recommended to ensure [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s made it across the water unharmed. It took about three days to cross the passage in a small vessel.<ref name="Into the Void" />
